description: Fires on bottom-row horizontal threats centred on column 4: strongest when the empty bottom cell of column 4 completes four for either side; also when the opponent has a bottom-row winning cell in columns 2-6, or a stone at the bottom of column 4 would make an open three. Vertical and higher-row threats do not count. Weak firing just above threshold (often late games, column 4 low) is diffuse and not captured.
effect: Pushes the move toward column 4: forcing it high raised column 4 by +0.46 and +0.96 probability on two positions; zeroing it while it fires changes nothing measurable (the model already blocks/plays column 4).
notes: Best dev F1 0.391 (P 0.69, R 0.27), AUROC 0.63; simulation share of ceiling -0.46. The top of the distribution is clean (band 9 = nearly all must-block at (0,4)), confirmed by minimal pairs; placing a stone at (0,4) removes it. But ~2/3 of firing sits just above the 1.39 threshold with no clean rule (tried low-row playable threats: F1 0.25; asymmetric own-win rule: 0.38). My own bottom wins away from col 4 usually do not fire; some open-three cases (e.g. 3,3,2,3,6) do not fire. Synthesis 3,3,6,6,2,0,0,1,5 reaches 60.0, beating dev max 56.9.
